cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.
